# Data Source (hush_image_pull_credentials)

The container registry credentials for pulling the Hush container images. They are issued per organization rather than per deployment, so the data source takes no arguments and every `hush_deployment` pulls with the same ones.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Issued per organization rather than per deployment, so there is nothing to
# look them up by.
data "hush_image_pull_credentials" "this" {}

output "hush_registry" {
  value = data.hush_image_pull_credentials.this.registry
}
```

### Kubernetes image pull secret

The sensor's Helm chart pulls with a `kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson` secret, which these credentials fill in:

```terraform
resource "kubernetes_secret" "hush_image_pull" {
  metadata {
    name      = "hush-image-pull"
    namespace = "hush-security"
  }

  type = "kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson"

  data = {
    ".dockerconfigjson" = jsonencode({
      auths = {
        (data.hush_image_pull_credentials.this.registry) = {
          username = data.hush_image_pull_credentials.this.username
          password = data.hush_image_pull_credentials.this.password
        }
      }
    })
  }
}
```

Name the secret in the chart's `image.pullSecretList`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password to authenticate against the registry with.
- `registry` (String) The registry the Hush container images are hosted on.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The registry, username and password in one opaque bundle, which the installers accept in place of the three.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) The username to authenticate against the registry with.
